name: iterate pairwise forces to equilibrium
mechanism: treat connected nodes as attracting and all nodes as repelling, move each node a small step along the net force, and repeat until movement is small

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Force-based algorithms (also known as force-directed algorithms or spring-based algorithms)' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph drawing:

requires: a distance in the embedding space
fails_when: local minima; sensitive to initial positions
instances: Force-based algorithms (also known as force-directed algorithms or spring-based algorithms)
